prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Formalize Your Pet's Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name and sign their official adoption paper before entering your desktop world.", "Official Adoption", "Pet Name"]
1: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is ready to live on your desktop. Here is how to summon, chat with, and manage them anytime."]
2: []
3: ["Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pet", "Log into your existing account to recover existing pets, or create a new profile to start fresh safely.", "Using the same email restores your existing desktop companions automatically.", "Cloud Restore Active", "Signing in with an existing account will restore your pet history."]
4: ["If your pet does not display on screen after launch, check system tray or display settings.", "Checking Screen Overlay & System Tray..."]
5: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Companion", "Select Instant Preset for immediate companionship, or Custom Companion to craft a unique pet from scratch.", "You can always add more pets later from your desktop menu."]
6: ["Pick Your Companion Archetype", "Browse companion personalities and live visual styles side-by-side."]
7: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet...", "We are preparing your pet's animations and behaviors. You will receive an alert when ready."]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready! Claim Your Welcome Pack", "Your pet is officially adopted! We added starter treats and custom accessories to your desktop inventory.", "Starter Pack Unlocked"]
9: ["Takes less than 2 minutes to bring your pet to life."]
